info.title: Brazil Gov Procurement & Bidding Radar (PNCP API + MCP Server)
info.description:
Extracts, filters, and enriches live Brazilian government public tenders (Pregão Eletrônico, Dispensa - Lei 14.133) from the official PNCP API with item-level pricing, ME/EPP flags, and LLM-ready RAG Markdown briefs.

### Enterprise B2B Value Proposition (Brazil Gov Procurement & Bidding Radar (PNCP API + MCP Server))
- **Target B2B Buyers:** GovCon Capture Teams, B2B Sales Intelligence Platforms, and ERP Tender Modules.
- **Zero External API Keys Required:** Connects directly to authoritative government, regulatory, and financial primary registries with built-in retry/backoff and deterministic schema normalization.
- **Quantitative Scoring & RAG Briefs:** Every record is enriched with a quantitative 0-100 risk/viability score and an LLM-ready Markdown executive brief (`Public Tender Analyzed & Enriched`).
- **Backend Proxy Secret Injection:** RapidAPI Studio and Zyla API Hub inject `Authorization: Bearer <APIFY_API_TOKEN>` invisibly at the proxy layer when forwarding synchronous calls to `https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/b2b-quant-apis~b2b-gov-procurement-pncp-radar/run-sync-get-dataset-items`.
- **Marketplace Categories:** RapidAPI `Business` | Zyla API Hub `Government & Legal`.
- **Subscription Tiers (USD):** `BASIC` ($0.00/mo, 15 req/mo hard cap), `PRO` ($19.00/mo, 1,000 req/mo + $0.02/extra), `ULTRA` ($49.00/mo, 5,000 req/mo + $0.015/extra), `MEGA` ($149.00/mo, 25,000 req/mo + $0.010/extra).
- **SEO Keywords:** brazil-procurement, pncp, public-tenders, b2g-leads, government-contracts, lei-14133, bidding-radar.

B2bGovProcurementPncpRadarRequest.title: Brazil Gov Procurement & Bidding Radar (PNCP API + MCP Server) Request Schema
B2bGovProcurementPncpRadarRequest.description: Input parameters for Brazil Gov Procurement & Bidding Radar (PNCP API + MCP Server).

uf.title: State (UF)
uf.description: Two-letter Brazilian state code (e.g., SP, RJ, MG, PR, RS, SC, BA). Leave empty to search nationwide.

keywords.title: Target Keywords (Filter by Product/Service)
keywords.description: Optional list of keywords to filter tenders by object or item description (case-insensitive, accent-insensitive). Leave empty to return all tenders.

codigoModalidadeContratacao.title: Procurement Modality Code (Lei 14.133)
codigoModalidadeContratacao.description: 6 = Pregão Eletrônico (Most common), 8 = Dispensa de Licitação, 4 = Concorrência Eletrônica.

dataInicial.title: Start Date (YYYYMMDD)
dataInicial.description: Publication start date in YYYYMMDD format. If omitted, defaults to 15 days ago.

dataFinal.title: End Date (YYYYMMDD)
dataFinal.description: Publication end date in YYYYMMDD format. If omitted, defaults to today.

maxResults.title: Max Tenders to Extract
maxResults.description: Maximum number of matched tenders to output (Pay-Per-Event cap protection).

fetchItems.title: Enrich with Detailed Item List & Unit Prices
fetchItems.description: If enabled, queries the PNCP Items API for each matched tender to extract individual items, quantities, unit reference prices, and ME/EPP exclusivity.
